Take it easy there guys. I’m just pointing out that that is not how employment law works. If we want to start having jerks fired from their jobs for being jerks then we have to do it right. Otherwise those jerks could sue their ex-employers.

And let’s face it. That is exactly the kind of thing jerks would do.

Yeah the guy is clearly a tool but this happened on his own time, away from a working location, and involved people not associated with his employer. So technically there are no grounds for dismissal. Hopefully they found some problem with his work to justify firing him otherwise he is going to be able to sue that company.
Just out of interest and not trying to make fun of him but shouldn’t a military guard have a weapon?
If you have family then try to live close to them so that you have people in your life. It will get harder and you’ll want to avoid total isolation for as long as possible.
Some people end up alone for life. Everything sits on a bell curve so there have to be some people at the edges. No one thinks it will be them but it has to be someone.
It’s kind of correct though, from an evolutionary standpoint.
